title: Informed Consent
description: The child may not fully understand or provide informed consent for the transmission of their GPS coordinates, leading to potential misuse of their location data.

title: Data Interception
description: The live GPS coordinates transmitted from the child's device to the backend could be intercepted by unauthorized parties during transmission.

title: Data Retention
description: The backend may retain the GPS coordinates longer than necessary, increasing the risk of unauthorized access or misuse of the data.

title: Unintended Use of Data
description: The backend may use the GPS data for purposes other than originally intended, such as marketing or profiling, without the child's consent.

title: Location Data Leakage
description: The mobile app backend may inadvertently expose sensitive location data when writing to the Location History Store, leading to unauthorized access or sharing of user location information.

title: Unauthorized Access to Location History
description: The Location History Store may be vulnerable to unauthorized access, allowing attackers to retrieve sensitive location data stored in the database.

title: Interception of Location Data
description: Location data being transmitted from the mobile app backend to the Location History Store may be intercepted by malicious actors during transit, leading to potential misuse of the data.

title: Location Data Exposure
description: The mobile app backend may inadvertently expose sensitive location data when forwarding location pings to the Geofencing Engine, potentially allowing unauthorized access to user location information.

title: Interception of Location Data
description: Location pings transmitted from the mobile app backend to the Geofencing Engine could be intercepted during transmission, leading to unauthorized access to user location data.

title: Improper Data Handling
description: The Geofencing & Alert Engine may improperly handle or store the received location data, leading to potential misuse or unauthorized sharing of sensitive user information.

title: Unauthorized Access to Family Account Data
description: An unauthorized user may gain access to the Family Account Store, leading to exposure of sensitive location data.

title: Inaccurate Geofencing Alerts
description: If the Geofencing & Alert Engine processes incorrect or outdated zone definitions, it may trigger false alerts, leading to confusion or panic.

title: Data Leakage During Transmission
description: Data being transmitted from the Family Account Store to the Geofencing Engine may be intercepted, leading to unauthorized access to location data.

title: Unauthorized Data Sharing
description: The Geofencing Engine may inadvertently share location data with unauthorized parties, leading to privacy violations.

title: Data Interception
description: The arrival/departure notifications could be intercepted during transmission, allowing unauthorized access to sensitive location information.

title: Inadequate Data Protection at Destination
description: The Parent may not have adequate measures in place to protect the received location data, leading to potential misuse or unauthorized access.

title: Inadequate Consent
description: The parent may not fully understand what data is being collected or how it will be used, leading to inadequate consent for data processing.

title: Data Breach Risk
description: The mobile app backend may be vulnerable to data breaches, exposing sensitive information about the child and parent.

title: Insecure Data Storage
description: The child's profile data may be stored insecurely, making it susceptible to unauthorized access.

title: Metadata Leakage
description: During the data transmission, metadata such as the parent's location or device information may be exposed, potentially linking the parent to the child's profile.

title: Data Misuse by Third Parties
description: The mobile app backend may share data with third parties without proper safeguards, leading to potential misuse of the child's information.

title: Unauthorized Access to Account Data
description: The mobile app backend may inadvertently expose account data if proper authentication and authorization mechanisms are not in place, allowing unauthorized users to access sensitive information.

title: Data Breach of Stored Information
description: The Family Account & Permissions Store may be vulnerable to data breaches, leading to unauthorized access to child profiles and geofence zone data.

title: Interception of Data in Transit
description: Data being transmitted from the mobile app backend to the Family Account & Permissions Store could be intercepted by malicious actors, leading to potential exposure of sensitive information.

title: Informed Consent
description: The parent may not be fully informed about what data is being shared with the mobile app backend, leading to a lack of informed consent.

title: Data Retention
description: The mobile app backend may retain location data longer than necessary, increasing the risk of unauthorized access or misuse.

title: Identity Disclosure
description: The data flow may expose metadata that could be used to identify the parent or child, leading to potential privacy breaches.

title: Unintended Data Sharing
description: The mobile app backend may unintentionally share location data with third parties without the parent's knowledge or consent.

title: Unauthorized Access to Location History
description: An unauthorized entity may gain access to the stored location history when it is shared from the DataStore, leading to potential misuse of sensitive location data.

title: Insecure Data Processing
description: The Mobile App Backend may process the retrieved location history insecurely, potentially exposing it to unauthorized access or leaks during processing.

title: Data Leakage in Transit
description: While the location history is being transmitted from the DataStore to the Mobile App Backend, there is a risk of data leakage, which could expose sensitive information to third parties.

title: Improper Data Retention
description: The Mobile App Backend may retain the location history longer than necessary, increasing the risk of unauthorized access or data breaches.

title: Unintentional Data Sharing
description: The parent may unintentionally share sensitive location data with the secondary guardian without fully understanding the implications of this action.

title: Interception of Data in Transit
description: The location data being transmitted from the parent to the mobile app backend could be intercepted by unauthorized parties during transmission.

title: Inadequate Data Protection at Destination
description: The mobile app backend may not have adequate security measures in place to protect the location data once it is received, leading to potential unauthorized access.

title: Unclear User Consent
description: The secondary guardian may not be fully informed about the data being shared and how it will be used, leading to potential misuse of the location data.

title: Unauthorized Access to Location Data
description: The mobile app backend may inadvertently grant access to unauthorized secondary guardians, leading to potential misuse of the child's live location data.

title: Insecure Storage of Location Data
description: The secondary guardian may store the child's live location data insecurely, leading to potential data breaches or unauthorized access.

title: Data Interception During Transmission
description: The child's live location data may be intercepted during transmission from the backend to the secondary guardian, leading to unauthorized access.

title: Inadequate Data Minimization
description: The backend may share more data than necessary for the purpose of analytics, leading to potential overexposure of user data.

title: Insecure Data Storage
description: The advertising/analytics partner may not store the aggregated data securely, leading to unauthorized access or data breaches.

title: Data Linkability
description: Aggregated data may still allow for the identification of individual users when combined with other data sources, leading to privacy concerns.

title: Misuse of Data
description: The advertising/analytics partner may use the aggregated data for purposes beyond what was agreed upon, such as targeted advertising without user consent.

title: User Unawareness
description: Users may not be aware that their aggregated usage data is being shared with third parties, leading to a lack of informed consent.

title: Unintentional Data Sharing
description: The child may unintentionally share their location with unintended recipients if the SOS message is sent to the wrong contact or if the mobile app is misconfigured.

title: Interception of Data in Transit
description: The SOS message containing the child's location could be intercepted during transmission, allowing unauthorized parties to access sensitive information.

title: Insecure Data Storage
description: The mobile app backend may store the child's location data insecurely, making it vulnerable to unauthorized access or data breaches.

title: Unauthorized Use of Data
description: The mobile app backend may use the child's location data for purposes other than intended, such as marketing or analytics, without proper consent.
